## Historical audit: S0092

**Scope.** Student trajectory, chunk 3 of 3 only. Original file: `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/replay_s1/H_start/H_start/replay_development/commons_2238909/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file; character ranges are those supplied for each observation.

| Evidence | Observed operations and results |
|---|---|
| Line 22, `model_request`, chars [0,266156) | The task was an editable reconstruction of a single indoor RGB image, matching camera, geometry, colors, placement and materials. The student’s anchors **interpret** it as an archive corridor; the reference image itself is not visible in this audit. |
| Line 22, same range | The first program defines multiple separate objects: architecture, 25 grouped shelving banks, a book bay, carts, fixtures and a sign. Bank groups include panels, locks, wheels and crank components; grouping and intended placement do not independently establish physical connection. Colors, roughness and emission are specified, but no image texture is used in the visible code. The scene is static; object pose and actual contacts are not visually verified. |
| Line 22, same range | After step 1, the student diagnosed a misplaced vanishing point, pale surfaces and an exposed cabinet side, then changed camera position/yaw, colors and lighting in step 2. After step 2, the student identified foreground handles, high plaques and pale surfaces; step 3 added a second foreground handle, lowered plaques, darkened materials and fill, and changed camera target height. These are student diagnoses and executed code changes, not verified improvements. |
| Line 22, same range | Harness feedback reports steps 1–3 `ok: true`, finished renders and saved Blender scenes. The logs show 16 samples despite code requesting 32; the cause is not established. Render and reference image paths were supplied, but their pixels are unavailable here. |
| Lines 22–25, respective chars [0,266156), [0,4395), [0,363), [0,59) | With no executions remaining, the student was instructed to compare all three and select one. The read-only session reports zero tool calls and completion; the student answered `SELECT 3`, and the subsequent `select` event records step 3. Selection is not independent geometric or visual verification. |

**Teacher input and exploration.** No teacher feedback or teacher adoption is visible in this chunk. The harness supplied execution results and comparison instructions; the student’s two revisions constitute autonomous iteration within that interface, not evidence of teacher-directed changes. The final selection session had tools disabled and reports none used. Earlier unseen chunks cannot establish or exclude other input.

**Outcome and lessons.** Three builds formally succeeded and step 3 was selected. Reconstruction correctness, visual similarity, part connectivity, occlusion, camera pose, material appearance and lighting quality remain **unknown**; neither a failure nor full correctness is established. Transferably, separating camera, large color regions and local geometry makes revision decisions traceable, while successful execution alone does not validate a scene. The specific handle count, plaque height and darkening are task-specific hypotheses whose effectiveness remains unresolved without the images.
